text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the final day of the camp, at Rice 
Shower's request, we continued training 
until the very last minute—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! I'm sorry I'm late...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry, Rice-chaaan! The bus and 
everyone are waiting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thank goodness, I made it in 
time.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to everyone waiting for 
us.

It's all thanks to everyone waiting for 
us, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I gotta go say thank you to 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! Actually, it looks like 
the road was closed just a minute ago.

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
There's a chance our return to the academy 
might be delayed by about two hours...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorryyy...! It's all Rice's 
fauuult...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...All the way back to the academy that 
day, I spent the entire time soothing Rice 
Shower, who tried to apologize to every 
single person we passed.
